title: VideoExpress Agent Intake Configuration Schema
description: Structured intake parameters collected at the start of a new VideoExpress production run before spending credits or generating assets.

video_type.description: Primary narrative format and pacing profile for the video.

visual_style.description: Locked visual style applied across Master Character, Location References, Image Prompts, and VideoExpress select-type dropdown.

aspect_ratio.description: Project-wide aspect ratio invariant (Landscape 16:9 or Vertical 9:16 only; 1:1 is never used).

target_seconds.description: Explicit target duration in seconds when preset is custom_seconds or user specifies a runtime.

input_mode.description: Whether the user provided just a Title/Context idea (Agent writes full script & beats) or a Full Script (Agent segments & calibrates beats).

title_or_topic.description: Working title or central topic of the video.

context_notes.description: Optional context, tone, protagonist traits, setting, or moral/takeaway when input_mode is title_and_context.

full_script_text.description: Complete narration or scene-by-scene script when input_mode is full_script.

route.description: In-app VideoExpress CloneVoice narration + Auto Align, OR Studio Hybrid pipeline with mouth-locked video clips, -14 LUFS voiceover, and -20dB sidechain-ducked BGM.

narrator_voice.description: System voice name (e.g., Beau Whitaker, en-US-ChristopherNeural, Lilly) or authorized cloned voice.

mouth_lock_enabled.description: Enforce sealed closed-lip smile and non-mouth emotional expression when narration is third-person voiceover.

atomic_dropzone_publish.description: When enabled, delivers Thumbnail (.jpg) FIRST, Master Video (.mp4) SECOND, and Metadata (.md) LAST to YUploader dropzone.
